answer: A PreToolUse hook (hooks/deployed_copy_edit.py) looks up IMP-0033 provenance records. A live path with a record pointing at a repo blob injects an advisory naming CANONICAL_REPO_PATH=skills/known/SKILL.md. A live-only path in the same tree with no record stays silent, as does an edit of the repo source. Removing the record (negative control) removes the warning, proving the record — not a path prefix — is the trigger. The hook always continues with permissionDecision=allow (inject, never block). Forced internal errors exit 0 and fail open. SUCCESS:IMP-0037
